items.citation:
# Candidate observation

## English

This preliminary observation is associated with [JSP-000598 — Can two distinct central binomial coefficients have exactly the same prime divisors?](https://github.com/TheJustinSunPrize/awards/blob/main/problems/catalog-0501-0600.md#JSP-000598). It publishes `Statement.lean` and `Proof.lean` for the explicit witness `n = 87`, `m = 88` in the existential reading of the question, using the public source cited in the catalog. It does not claim a classification of repeated prime supports, a formalization or solution of the full catalog question, or a change to the catalog's status.

A local Lean compilation was run with Lean 4.33.1 and the pinned Mathlib revision. That compiler result is only a reproducibility check; it is not independent verification of statement faithfulness or official JSP verification.

The candidate remains under verification. No award decision, recipient identity, solver or formalizer credit, payment, or official verification is asserted.
